entries.title: Otogi: Myth of Demons

emulation.emulator: Official Xbox backward compatibility; xemu for preservation testing
emulation.notes: Prefer the official Xbox Store/backward-compatible route. Use xemu only for owned-copy preservation research.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox game running through Microsoft's backward-compatibility layer on modern Xbox hardware.

primary.why: The official Xbox backward-compatible release is the best modern route because it keeps the original Xbox game playable on current Xbox hardware and the Xbox Store sells the same title digitally.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Otogi: Myth of Demons from the Xbox Store, or insert an owned compatible Xbox disc on supported Xbox One or Xbox Series hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is backward compatibility, not a remake or asset-level remaster.
